text: Could you make a matching set of promotional assets for Rooftop Jazz, because I’d like them to feel like they belong together? I’m excited about this event and have probably been overthinking how the promotion will look. What I need is a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. The details to put on each are 17 October 2027 / 7 PM / Atlas Roof / Free entry. Please go with a cream-and-burgundy jazz-club look for the whole set.
